title: observability: token-level KV metrics, structured logging, grafana dashboard and alert tuning
author: Ethan Brown
description: Context: production workloads show increased tail token latency and unclear unit economics for KV-backed serving. This PR adds token-level KV cache and serving metrics, structured request/response logging for downstream cost attribution, a Grafana dashboard for per-route token cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned alert rules to reduce noise while catching regressions. Changes include new Prometheus metrics (kv_cache_hits_total, kv_cache_miss_total, token_latency_ms_bucketed, token_cost_cents_total), OpenTelemetry span attributes for per-token tracing, structured JSON logs with cost/latency fields, dashboard panels with cost/latency heatmaps, and adjusted alert thresholds based on production percentiles. Checklist: [x] Add metrics and expose via /metrics endpoint [x] Instrument KV cache and serving path [x] Add structured logger and enrich requests with route/model metadata [x] Grafana dashboard + panels + templating variables [x] Alert rules updated and documented [x] Unit + integration tests for metrics exports Motivation: give SREs and product engineering actionable observability into per-token economics and tail latency while keeping alert noise low. Related: ENG-3124 (kv cache telemetry), ENG-3580 (dashboard work), incident SUP-1942 for a latency spike on 2026-02-10.
